statement: For L_n as frozen verbatim in source.md and interpreted in problem.md, there are no d>0 and 42-element V contained in {2,...,529-d} for which the 84 integers v and v+d are all distinct and pairwise coprime. Consequently no such witness exists for any x<=529, so L_42>=530 and the original equality L_42=529 is false.
contribution: A complete exact exclusion of the original equality. Parity eliminates every odd gap. For each of all 263 even gaps d=2,4,...,526, the evidence supplies and directly verifies a proper coloring with at most 41 colors of the complete gcd-compatibility graph, excluding a 42-clique. This conclusion is reproducible with dependency-free exact-integer checks and does not rely on the inaccessible supplied L_41 paper; no priority claim is made.
